name: No Peek Poker
description: No Peek Poker is a variant of Indian Poker (also known as Blind Man's Bluff) where players hold their single card against their forehead without looking at it, so all other players can see it except themselves. It combines elements of poker betting with the unique mechanic of playing blind to your own card while seeing everyone else's.

content.text: No Peek Poker is a variant of Indian Poker (also known as Blind Man's Bluff) where players hold their single card against their forehead without looking at it, so all other players can see it except themselves. It combines elements of poker betting with the unique mechanic of playing blind to your own card while seeing everyone else's.

No Peek Poker is a variant of Indian Poker, which has been played in America since at least the early 20th century. The game is also known as Blind Man's Bluff poker. The 'no peek' aspect emphasizes the social and bluffing elements over card knowledge.
Standard 52-card pack. Cards rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. Ace is typically high.
Standard deck, poker chips for betting.
One card dealt face-down to each player. Players place card against forehead without looking at it.

items.text: Multiple Cards: Some variants deal 2-3 cards that players arrange on forehead.
Community Cards: Texas Hold'em style with community cards combined with forehead cards.
